title: Inheritance Processing Fee
scenario: A letter says a distant relative left money but legal fees must be paid first.

answers.A: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.B: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.
answers.D: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.

explanation: Inheritance Processing Fee: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Unexpected inheritance fees are a classic advance-fee scam.
